# Lab 4.4: Window (Analytic) Functions

## What We Are Going to Do
Use ROW_NUMBER, RANK, LAG/LEAD, running totals and moving averages with window frames.

## Steps

1. **[SQL] Daily revenue table.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">CREATE TABLE lab04.daily_revenue AS
SELECT DATE(created_at) AS day, ROUND(SUM(sale_price), 2) AS revenue
FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.order_items`
WHERE status = 'Complete'
GROUP BY day;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


2. **[SQL] Running total and 7-day moving average.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">SELECT
  day, revenue,
  SUM(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY day) AS running_total,
  AVG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY day ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS ma_7d
FROM lab04.daily_revenue
ORDER BY day DESC
LIMIT 14;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


3. **[SQL] Day-over-day change with LAG.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">SELECT day, revenue,
  revenue - LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY day) AS change_vs_yesterday,
  LEAD(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY day) AS tomorrow
FROM lab04.daily_revenue
ORDER BY day DESC LIMIT 10;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


4. **[SQL] Rank products inside each category.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">SELECT category, name, retail_price,
  RANK() OVER w AS rnk,
  DENSE_RANK() OVER w AS dense_rnk,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER w AS row_num
FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.products`
QUALIFY row_num &lt;= 3
WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY retail_price DESC)
ORDER BY category, row_num;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


5. **[CLI] ROWS vs RANGE frames.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">bq query --use_legacy_sql=false '
WITH t AS (SELECT * FROM UNNEST([STRUCT(1 AS x, 10 AS v), (2, 20), (2, 30), (3, 40)]))
SELECT x, v,
  SUM(v) OVER (ORDER BY x ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rows_frame,
  SUM(v) OVER (ORDER BY x RANGE BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS range_frame
FROM t'</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   With `RANGE`, the two rows where `x = 2` share the same total.

## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Running total | Grows day by day |
| `LAG` / `LEAD` | Previous and next row values |
| `RANK` vs `DENSE_RANK` | Ties skip numbers vs no gaps |
| `ROWS` vs `RANGE` | Physical rows vs equal values |
